values: 发射箭雨对范围内敌人造成伤害。
Gwyneth rains down arrows, dealing damage to enemies within range.

被动的，普通攻击会蓄力较长时间，随后发射箭矢，对敌人造成360% ATK的伤害。每1点攻击速度或急速还会额外使自身普通攻击伤害提高0.1%。
主动释放时，选择一个地图格，对其发射覆盖其周围2格范围的箭雨，对范围内每个格子上的敌人造成270% + 35% ATK伤害并使其定身，持续2秒。每波箭雨命中相同目标的后续伤害降低80%。优先选择敌人最密集的区域进行释放。

Passive. After charging up for a longer time, Gwyneth's normal attack fires an arrow that deals 360% ATK damage. Every point of ATK SPD or Haste further increases her normal attack damage by 0.1%.
Active. Gwyneth selects a tile and rains arrows over it and all tiles within 2 tiles. Enemies on each affected tile take 270% + 35% ATK damage and become immobilized for 2s. For each wave of arrows, subsequent hits on the same target deal 80% less damage. This skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至290% + 35% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 290% + 35% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至310% + 35% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 310% + 35% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至330% + 35% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 330% + 35% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，造成的伤害提升至350% + 35% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 350% + 35% ATK when this skill is used actively.
发射“雷霆之矢”，对目标附近敌人造成溅射伤害和控制效果。
Gwyneth fires a Fulgur Arrow, dealing splash damage and inflicting control effects on enemies near the target.
被动地，格温妮丝的普通攻击以3次为一个循环。格温妮丝普通攻击循环中的第3次，为箭矢附加雷属性，使目标沉默1秒，对目标周围2格范围内所有敌人造成220% + 30% ATK的雷电溅射伤害，并附带0.5秒的眩晕。

Passive. Gwyneth's normal attacks follow a 3-attack cycle. Every 3rd attack is imbued with the power of lightning, silencing the target for 1s, dealing 220% + 30% ATK lightning splash damage to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target, and stunning affected enemies for 0.5s.
雷电溅射伤害提高至240% + 30% ATK。
Increases the lightning splash damage dealt to 240% + 30% ATK.
雷电溅射伤害提高至260% + 30% ATK。
Increases the lightning splash damage dealt to 260% + 30% ATK.
雷电溅射伤害提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the lightning splash damage dealt to 280% + 30% ATK.
发射“烈焰之矢”，对目标造成较高伤害并附加“燃烧”效果。
Gwyneth fires a Flare Arrow, dealing higher damage to the target and burning them.
格温妮丝普通攻击循环中的第2次，为箭矢附加火属性，对敌人造成的伤害提升至490% ATK，并对目标附加“燃烧”效果，使其每0.25秒受到20% + 2% ATK的伤害 ，持续4秒。 “燃烧”持续期间敌人受愈降低40点，不可叠加。

The 2nd attack in Gwyneth's normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of fire. It deals 490% ATK damage and burns the target, causing them to take 20% + 2% ATK damage every 0.25s for 4s. While burned, the target has their Vitality reduced by 40. The Vitality reduction cannot stack.
Increases the damage dealt to 510% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 530% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 550% ATK.
提高自身攻击速度，附近没有敌人时，进一步提高攻击速度。
Increases ATK SPD and gains an additional increase when there are no enemies nearby.
战斗中，自身提高15点攻击速度，当自身1格范围内连续3秒没有敌人时，额外提高9点攻击速度。
Increases ATK SPD by 15 during battle. If there are no enemies within 1 tile for 3s, further increases ATK SPD by 9.
战斗中，自身提高20点攻击速度，当自身1格范围内连续3秒没有敌人时，额外提高12点攻击速度。
Increases ATK SPD by 20 during battle. If there are no enemies within 1 tile for 3s, further increases ATK SPD by 12.
战斗中，自身提高25点攻击速度，当自身1格范围内连续3秒没有敌人时，额外提高15点攻击速度。
Increases ATK SPD by 25 during battle. If there are no enemies within 1 tile for 3s, further increases ATK SPD by 15.
同时触发“烈焰之矢”和“雷霆之矢”，对目标造成高额伤害并同时触发两种箭矢的效果。
Gwyneth triggers the Flare Arrow and Fulgur Arrow simultaneously, dealing high damage to the target and applying both arrows' effects at the same time.
格温妮丝普通攻击伤害提高20%。普通攻击循环中的第1次，为箭矢同时附加雷属性和火属性，并且会对雷电溅射到的其他敌人施加“燃烧”效果。
Gwyneth's normal attack damage is increased by 20%. The 1st attack in her normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of both lightning and fire, and it burns enemies hit by the lightning splash.
格温妮丝普通攻击伤害提高25%。
Increases Gwyneth's normal attack damage by 25%.
为箭矢同时附加雷属性和火属性时，还会对主目标额外附加其10%最大生命值的伤害，额外伤害不超过自身360%攻击力。且由本次箭矢造成的所有伤害无视敌人护甲带来的减伤效果的60%和受到伤害降低效果的4%，在非首领模式下，无视受到伤害降低效果的幅度提升至12%。

When an arrow is imbued with the power of both lightning and fire, it also deals extra damage to the main target equal to 10% of their max HP. This extra damage cannot exceed 360% of Gwyneth's ATK. All damage dealt by this arrow also ignores 60% of enemies' Phys DEF damage reduction, and 4% of all other damage taken reduction effects. In non-boss battles, this second value is increased to 12%.
格温妮丝普通攻击伤害提高30%。
Increases Gwyneth's normal attack damage by 30%.
附近没有敌人时，自身普通攻击间隔缩短。
Gwyneth reduces her normal attack interval when there are no enemies nearby.
在周围1格范围内连续3秒没有敌人时，格温妮丝能够进一步集中精神，使自身的普通攻击攻击间隔缩短40%。
If there are no enemies within 1 tile for 3s, Gwyneth focuses her aim, reducing the interval between her normal attacks by 40%.
